title: Two days in Ho Chi Minh City
summary: The center on the first day: the cathedral square, the palace, Ben Thanh, the War Remnants Museum, and cơm tấm. Cho Lon on the second: Binh Tay, Thien Hau, and the Jade Emperor.

days.title: Day 1 — The center
days.body: The cathedral square, Nguyen Hue, the Reunification Palace, Ben Thanh, cơm tấm, and the War Remnants Museum.

days.title: Day 2 — Cho Lon
days.body: Walk the clock gate at Binh Tay, then Thien Hau and the Jade Emperor. How long each hall takes is Check on arrival.
